about: compiler/sizes: symbol package grouping, linker entry filter, NFA regex matcher, ELF64/32 binary size reader, and size budget checker (SELFHOST-TASK-PROFMD-SIZES).

mutants.name: selfhost-sizes-package-cuts-generics
mutants.rule: Package must strip generic type arguments and method receivers before locating the package dot.

mutants.name: selfhost-sizes-regex-end-anchor
mutants.rule: Regex end-of-text anchor $ must advance only at the end of input.

mutants.name: selfhost-sizes-elf-exec-filter
mutants.rule: MeasureELFBytes must attribute Text bytes only from executable (SHF_EXECINSTR) sections.

mutants.name: selfhost-sizes-budget-raise-ledger
mutants.rule: ValidateFixtureLedger must reject fixtures whose ergoOnly ceiling exceeds base plus raises.
